children: Slovakia’s construction output rose by 2.3% year-on-year in July 2026, accelerating from a five-month low of a 1.0% increase in the previous month.

While it remained the second-slowest growth rate recorded this year, construction output reached almost EUR 805 million, exceeding EUR 800 million for the first time this year, largely driven by stronger domestic activity (4.7% vs 1.1% in June), with increased output for new construction (4.9% vs 2.8%) and repair and maintenance work (5.0% vs -1.6%).
By type of construction, building activity increased 6.5% (vs 2.7%), while civil engineering output rose 1.1% (-1.9%).
Meanwhile, construction output abroad fell 13.5% (vs -0.1%), marking the third-largest decline this year and significantly limiting the overall growth in the sector.
On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, construction output increased 1.9% in July.
In the first seven months of 2026, construction activity increased 8.2% compared with the same period a year earlier.

title: Slovakia Construction Output Accelerates in July
